CI-Bot: build-redwood/master #12345 failed on windows-2022-x64 (agent-win-03) — failing test: tests/integration/test_file_watcher.py::test_timeout
CI-Bot: <https://ci.redwood.com/build/12345|View logs> 

sara: Heads up — this is blocking the canary roll (we've got a deploy window in ~2h). Can someone bisect? It consistently times out on the watcher test on Windows. :grimacing:

matt: I'll grab it. Do we know the last green on master?

sara: Last green on master before the failure was commit 0a1b2c3d (merged ~3h ago). Suspect merge was PR #5128 (feat/kv-cache) but not sure.

julia: I can run the bisect on a Win VM if you want. Reproducer I use locally: `pytest tests/integration/test_file_watcher.py::test_timeout -q -k file_watcher` — times out in ~30s.

alex: FTR we saw a flake in a similar area last month caused by path normalization change in PR #5099. Worth checking overlap with new caching PR.

matt: Starting bisect on my Win VM now. Steps I run: `git fetch origin && git checkout master && git bisect start -- bad HEAD -- good 0a1b2c3d` then run the test in a loop. Will post first few results.

matt: bisect run -> first 6 commits tested: 4 good, 2 bad, narrowing down...

matt: Candidate bad commit: 0f9e7d2 (merge PR #5128) — reproduced the timeout locally. Stack trace shows hang in FileSystemWatcher._dispose_wait (waiting on IO thread).

sara: If that's reproducible, we should revert 5128 in canary immediately and re-run CI. Can someone open a revert PR?

kim: I'll open the revert PR and trigger canary. Creating revert now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5172

kim: Revert PR created and CI triggered. @ops-bot can you start a canary deploy once CI is green?

ops-bot: Canary deploy queued (env: canary-win, target: 2 nodes). Will start after CI passes.

matt: Verified locally that reverting 0f9e7d2 fixes the timeout on my Win VM. Good reproduction -> revert is the correct short-term fix.

sara: Thanks everyone. Kim — please hold the revert to merge on green and then ping me; I'll keep the deploy window. After canary is verified we can plan a proper fix with the kv-cache author.

CI-Bot: build #5172 (revert PR) completed — all Windows jobs passed. <https://ci.redwood.com/build/5172|logs>

ops-bot: Canary deploy started for revert PR (canary-win).

kim: Canary smoke tests passing (basic e2e + watcher tests) — marking as ✅ in the release notes. I'll follow up with a postmortem and link to the bisect notes.

sara: Awesome. Matt/julia — can you help with a short bisect note in #postmortems with commands/what reproduced? Keep it lightweight.

julia: On it. I'll paste the `git bisect` command history and the short repro steps in #postmortems.

matt: Thanks all — good teamwork. :raised_hands:
